test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_monotone_order_{n} (id UInt64, p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_monotone_order_{n} SELECT number, [ [(0.,0.),(0.,8.),(1.5 * {n} + 5,8.),(1.5 * {n} + 5,0.),(0.,0.)], [(1.5 * number + 1,1. + number % 2),(1.5 * number + 3,1. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 3,4. + number % 2),(1.5 * number + 1,4. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 1,1. + number % 2)] ] FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM (SELECT * FROM bench_monotone_order_{n} ORDER BY id DESC) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM (SELECT * FROM bench_monotone_order_{n} ORDER BY cityHash64(id)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
